To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

NoSQL databases are a new type of database management systems that are used to store large volumes of data, that they are not as strict as the traditional databases in terms of ACID, that they have the BASE trait and that they offer a high level of scalability and performance.

the NoSQL systems that are currently used are: (1) the key-value stores (which are the most used, but are also the simplest ones), (2) the document-oriented databases (which have a very good performance, but are also very complex), and (3) the column-oriented databases (which are the least used, but have the best performance).

NoSQL databases are not a single type of databases, but rather a set of database systems that are not based on the relational data model, and that are optimized for storing and retrieving large amounts of data, with high performance and scalability.

the following questions: What are the main NoSQL systems? What are the advantages and the disadvantages of each of the NoSQL solutions? What is the best NoSQL system for my needs? What are the main differences between the NoSQL systems and the relational databases?

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the NoSQL solutions are a good alternative to the traditional RDBMS (relational databases), and the best one for a given situation is determined by the specific needs (which are usually very different from case to case).
there is still no clear winner in the NoSQL arena, but the NoSQL systems are still a very good option in several use cases, as long as you know their strengths and limitations.
NoSQL is not an unified concept and that the various NoSQL solutions do not have a single unified approach.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have made a comparison between several NoSql databases using multiple criteria, we have presented the advantages and disadvantages of each of them, we have presented a comparison table and we have concluded that the best solution is to combine multiple NoSQL databases in order to obtain the best results for each of the criteria.
NoSQL systems are not only about the data model, they also provide a set of features and functionalities that make them more than just a simple data model.
the NoSQL systems have been designed to be used in specific cases and for specific needs, and that there is no one single solution that would be the best for all the situations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
NoSQL is still in its infancy and there are still many things to be done before it can really be used in production.
the NoSQL solutions are not all the same, but they are different, and they are not necessarily interchangeable, and that there is not a unique solution for all the problems.

there is not one single NoSQL solution which is better than the others in every aspect, but that the choice of the best solution depends on the specific needs of the user, which can be very different for different users.
